text:
Maya: quickcheck failure: embed-generation route in eu-west-2 is showing p99 spike and some 524s after the v4.1.0 deploy. canary rollout at 10% still.

Alex: are these from real user traffic or the synthetic quickcheck?

Maya: synthetic quickcheck first. ran 100 probes against the canary instances. 7x 524s, all on larger payloads (>1k tokens). p50/p95 look fine, tail is bad. sample below.

Maya: ```
$ curl -i -X POST https://eu-west-2.embed.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"long...","max_tokens":1200}' 
HTTP/1.1 524 A Timeout Occurred
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout", "backend":"embed-runtime"}
```

deploy-bot: Received. Pausing rollout for embed-service at stage=canary (10%). No new shards will be promoted. To rollback: `deploy rollback embed-service --to-version=v4.0.7 --reason=\"quickcheck 524s\"`.

Priya: quick thoughts: if it's payload-size-dependent maybe a streaming/chunking regression. options: pin traffic off canary, rollback to v4.0.7, or hotfix the runtime. pref fallback -> rollback.

Kevin: I agree. customer-facing route, tail latency spike = unacceptable. rollback + short hold in change window, then follow-up re-deploy after root cause.

Maya: starting rollback now: `deploy rollback embed-service --to-version=v4.0.7 --force` — ETA ~3m to drain. monitoring probes.

smokebot: synthetic rerun (n=120) -> 0 failures, p99 back within baseline across eu-west-2.

Alex: good. created bug INF-2201 with logs and reproducer, assigned to runtime-team (cc @Priya @Kevin). note mentions streaming/chunking/timeouts.

Priya: added release_notes entry: "Reverted embed-service v4.1.0 due to intermittent 524 timeout errors on large payloads; rolled back to v4.0.7 while investigation completes." Also updated the change window to reflect rollback and hold.

Maya: tagged runtime-team to triage grpc/http streaming path and payload handling. will coordinate a targeted re-deploy once the fix lands and we validate with a larger synthetic sweep.

Kevin: also add a quick test to the quickcheck suite to include large payloads as a guard.

Maya: opened follow-up task and test update in INF-2202. closing this thread — will post when re-deploy is scheduled. :thumbsup:
